$comment: The licences this repository has decided it accepts, and why the list is short.
It is not a catalogue of every permissive licence in existence: an identifier
is added when a dependency this project actually needs arrives with it, and
somebody has read it. An unlisted licence is not 'bad' -- it is unreviewed,
which is a different and more honest thing to report.
One file for both languages. web/scripts/audit-licenses.mjs reads the npm
tree and scripts/audit_licenses.py reads the Python one, so a licence
decision is made once for the repository rather than once per ecosystem.
A 'reviewed' entry names the licence it was granted for, because that is
what somebody read. Bound to the package name alone, the exception would
outlive the licence: a relicensed package would keep passing the gate under
a decision nobody made about it.
This is an engineering gate, not legal advice. See docs/legal/third-party-notices.md.

pathspec.reason: A build-time dependency of the linter, used unmodified and never shipped in the runtime image. File-level copyleft reaches modified MPL files, of which this repository has none.
